data.name: MainDescription
data.value: Setup will verify the installation media and initialize the code-signing service.

data.name: PdfDescription
data.value: Setup will verify the offline extension media and install PDF-signing support.

data.name: ErrorRequiredRuntimeMissing
data.value: The .NET 10 Windows x64 runtimes required by SimplySignAuto are missing. Install ASP.NET Core Runtime and .NET Desktop Runtime, then run Setup again. ASP.NET Core Runtime: https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0 .NET Desktop Runtime: https://dotnet.microsoft.com/en-us/download/dotnet/10.0/runtime

data.name: ErrorSimplySignDesktopMissing
data.value: Certum SimplySign Desktop (Windows 64-bit) is not installed. Install it, then run Setup again. Download: https://support.certum.eu/en/software/procertum-smartsign/

data.name: ErrorSimplySignPkcs11Missing
data.value: C:\Windows\System32\SimplySignPKCS.dll was not found. Repair or reinstall Certum SimplySign Desktop (Windows 64-bit). Download: https://support.certum.eu/en/software/procertum-smartsign/

data.name: ErrorOsUnsupported
data.value: This Windows version or edition combination is not supported. Supported systems include x64 Windows 10 22H2, supported Windows 10 LTSC and Windows 11 versions, and Windows Server 2019/2022/2025 with Desktop Experience.

data.name: ErrorDesktopExperienceRequired
data.value: The automatic-signing service requires Windows Server Desktop Experience. Server Core is not supported.

data.name: ErrorArchitectureUnsupported
data.value: SimplySignAuto supports only x64 Windows. Run the 64-bit installer on a 64-bit operating system.

data.name: ErrorAdministratorRequired
data.value: Administrator privileges are required. Right-click Setup, select “Run as administrator”, and try again.

data.name: ErrorDomainControllerUnsupported
data.value: Installation on a domain controller is not supported. Use a workgroup computer, domain-member client, or member server.

data.name: ErrorAutoLogonConflict
data.value: An existing AutoLogon configuration was detected. The automatic-signing service requires exclusive use of this configuration, and Setup will not overwrite it. Disable the existing AutoLogon configuration securely, then run Setup again.

data.name: ErrorAutoLogonPlaintextPasswordPresent
data.value: A legacy plaintext AutoLogon password is present in the registry. Use the original configuration tool to remove it securely before installation; Setup will not read or overwrite the password.

data.name: ErrorGeneric
data.value: Setup did not complete. Review the system requirements, correct the reported problem, and run Setup again.
